title: Vitrea has been updated
summary: Real photo wallpapers, a new lock screen and a calmer look.
items: An on-screen keyboard appears when you tap a text field (also on the lock and login screens), and the screen turns when you rotate a tablet.
For slower computers like the Surface Go: no glass or blur, shorter animations, lighter file search. Turns itself on for low-power computers; switch it in Vitrea Style > Performance.
Neutral grey colours with one accent colour taken from your wallpaper, plain window buttons, solid menus. The big desktop clock and Yumeka are now optional (Vitrea Style).
Lake, Mist, Forest and Ember, in Vitrea Style. The lock screen uses the same photo.
A clock on your photo; start typing to unlock.
On computers installed with Vitrea's default disk layout, a snapshot is taken before every update. If an update breaks something, pick an earlier version from the boot menu.
Meta+Shift+S snips part of the screen; Print opens Spectacle. Pictures are saved to Pictures/Screenshots and copied to the clipboard.
Meta+V (the Windows key + V; Control+V on a Mac keyboard) shows everything you copied recently.
KDE Connect: install the KDE Connect app on your phone to share files, see notifications and use it as a remote.
The screen gets warmer in the evening (7 pm to 6:30 am). Change it in System Settings > Display > Night Light.
Cmd works like Ctrl (Cmd+C, Cmd+V, Cmd+Q...), Cmd+Space searches, Cmd+Shift+4 snips. Touch Bar and fan settings are in Vitrea Style.
Swipe three fingers left or right to switch desktops; pinch four fingers to see all windows.
